High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Punishing One (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (Dagobah, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Punishing One _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qsGzaeBCE36ldZmMfiWChrFy6lVtNE_x/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Punishing One _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,056 bytes, SHA-256 <code>626660e4a7a70ff58719141b4a3af662e26ae0aacc2212877abe3e204751cbad</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.5, 48.0, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

This is a fan print, not a Decipher or Players Committee card. It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set, not a PC or Decipher publication)” and is not shown on [[Punishing One (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (Bill, 22 November 2026).

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
